basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast based in Southern California. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which gives me the flexibility to explore my various hobbies. I'm passionate about virtual reality and constantly keep up with the latest advancements in tech. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my nights surfing Reddit and engaging in niche communities. My interests range from tech innovations to alternative lifestyle discussions. I dislike judgmental attitudes and prefer open-minded and respectful conversations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have always been a tech geek. Most of my knowledge comes from years of self-teaching through online courses and forums. I'm particularly knowledgeable about diabetes management tech due to a family member's condition.
